_about: phrases: t0..t1 is what a cursor reads (t0 = the onset less the pre-roll). clearDb = the attack over the 60 ms before it; under 10 dB the start gets fadeIn. dipDb = how far the end sits under the phrase's own level. impacts: from 'library' = J's accepted attacks; 'scan' = proposed. loudDb = an impact's loudest 50 ms under its envelope; gainDb = what brings it to the median of his attacks (the page applies it when normalizing is on).
